paper_metadata.title: Mechanical properties of dual-phase alloys of B2 and icosahedral phases in the Al–Cu–Fe system

evidence.quote: Intermetallic alloys with B2 structure and dual-phase alloys of the B2 phase and an icosahedral (i-) phase have been produced

Four alloys with the compositions Al 40Fe60 (alloy 1), Al 41Cu11Fe48 (2), Al 44.5Cu25.5Fe33 (3) and Al 46Cu32Fe22 (4), which are in the B2 single-phase region, and an alloy with the composition Al 55Cu29.5Fe15.5 (5), which is in the two-phase region of the B2 phase and the i-phase, were produced by arc-melting.

conflicts.description: Yield stress measurement at 400 K could not be obtained for the annealed alloy 5 due to fracture, whereas the as-cast alloy 5 yielded without fracture at temperatures down to 400 K.

evidence.quote: For the alloy 5 after annealing, the yield stress could not be measured due to fracture at temperatures below 630 K while the alloy 5 before annealing exhibited yielding without fracture at temperatures down to 400 K.
